_comment: Stake Bonus Drop Tracker config — copy to config.json and fill what you need. Watching public Telegram previews works with ZERO credentials. GraphQL validation (read-only) needs a stake.us session token — Stake requires login even for code checks; env vars CODESTATS_STAKE_US_TOKEN etc. override these fields (handy for GitHub Actions secrets). For free instant validation of every drop, use the live feed at https://codestats.gg
